items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls/mechanics observed: W/S move forward/back; A/D strafe; diagonals work but often catch narrow frames or overshoot openings. Mouse dx>0 turns right, dx<0 left; dy<0 looks down, dy>0 up. Arrow taps can rotate farther than expected, so brief taps/small mouse adjustments are better for alignment. E interacts with prompts; J swings melee. A crowbar pickup was confirmed early; an axe is equipped now, with no firearm equipped. J killed several close infected, but swinging near Rochelle caused a friendly-fire warning. W+Space was used for forward jumps on the rooftop.

Pickups/health: Early rooftop pistol/table-kit acquisition was never confirmed despite labels disappearing; adrenaline pickups also remained unproven. A floor first-aid kit persisted through repeated E attempts, and slots 1/4 previously showed no useful visible change. Health previously fell through attacks, bile, and acid, unexpectedly rose from 22 to 84 without an isolated cause, later decayed from temporary-looking values, and Ellis explicitly healed the player to 80. Health remained 80 throughout the recent stairwell/rooftop section; teammates appeared healthy whenever visible. On the new rooftop, a clearly centered “Get first aid” prompt disappeared after one E press, but the kit remained visible on plywood; acquisition is unresolved, so do not repeatedly retry it.

Earlier route/hazards: The initial rooftop doorway led through a switchback descent to “FLOOR 0,” rooms 800/801, a cleaning cart, bloodstained corridors, and a larger window/counter room. A bench/bright-window branch was a dead end. Avoid glowing acid (“Avoid the noxious acid!”) and check teammate labels before attacking distant figures. Boomer bile, Smoker/Hunter/Jockey/Boomer encounters and teammate kills were reported earlier. Do not return to the troublesome original rooftop supplies.

Recent stairwell route: From the wall corner, a Left turn exposed the bloodstained teammate-marked doorway ahead-right. W+D reached it but caught the right wall; W stopped at a dark frame with the lit opening left; W+A cleared it. Beyond was a small landing with an unexamined red object against the back wall and stairs right. A blue-highlighted item on a lower step was passed without testing pickup. Repeated short turns and straight climbs were needed: approaches caught the left railing and several landing walls. A right pipe corner was a dead end. The continuing switchback flights were found by turning toward visible steps; Coach, Rochelle, and Ellis regrouped near one stair base. A lower landing also had an open doorway that was not entered. Higher up, a lit exit was visible across a railing; brief Left/Right corrections centered it, and W crossed the open landing. At the threshold, W caught the right doorframe, then W+A successfully exited onto a rooftop. No enemies appeared during this section.

Rooftop observations/failures: After the inconclusive ground-kit interaction, W reached a low parapet with chain-link fencing beyond. Plywood angled up against its right side. Three W+Space attempts failed to cross: the first from a distance, the second after moving flush to the plywood, and a longer third attempt while against it. The second reached the plywood but not the other side. This does not prove the crossing impossible by every method, but the repeated forward-jump strategy failed and should stop. S backed clear; Left and then A revealed continuous fenced parapet ahead, an open rooftop strip to the left, and the supply corner to the right. The final command was another Left turn for 0.35 s; execution completed, but no post-turn screenshot was supplied.

Active goal/uncertainty: Find an onward rooftop route, currently hypothesized to lie along the open left perimeter via a walkway, gap, or doorway; this is unobserved. Follow/rejoin teammates and continue toward the exit, using the axe only on confirmed infected. If the left perimeter dead-ends, reassess rather than repeating the plywood jump; the stairwell’s unentered lower-landing doorway remains a noted location, not a proven alternate route. The result of the final Left turn is the immediate unknown.
